scope: Species contrasts in the stage-02 library are MODELLED (config §3) on a real measured leaf base, and are swept in stage 05. This stage validates the falsification machinery and shows the form of the Phase 0 deliverable. It establishes nothing about Hong Kong material.

predictions_foliage.measures: Wavelength of maximum first derivative across the red edge
predictions_foliage.falsification: Mikania mean REP does not exceed the native-climber mean REP by at least 1 nm in the ground spectral library, in either season, at p < 0.05 by a site-blocked test.
predictions_foliage.why_broadband_misses: Multispectral gives a red-edge BAND, not a POSITION.

traits.trait: Altered standing chlorophyll pool and chlorophyll a/b ratio
traits.rationale: Selection on photoreaction genes and divergent expression of photosynthetic pathway genes act on the light-harvesting apparatus. Light-harvesting complex composition sets the chlorophyll a/b ratio and the total pigment pool per unit leaf area. This is the least contentious of the trait inferences, but it is still an inference: transcript abundance is not pigment concentration.

findings.source: Liu B. et al. (2020) Nature Communications 11:340

findings.claim: Evolution and diurnal expression patterns of photosynthetic pathway genes diverge from congeners
findings.source: The Crop Journal (2023) — diurnal expression of photosynthetic pathway genes in M. micrantha

findings.claim: Comparative transcriptomics against native congeners shows divergence in photosynthesis and secondary-metabolite pathways
findings.source: Comparative transcriptome analysis of M. micrantha with native congeners

test.note: effect present and in the predicted direction

predictions_foliage.measures: First- and second-derivative shape across the red edge (not just its peak)
predictions_foliage.expected_magnitude: detectable as a multivariate contrast, not a scalar offset
predictions_foliage.falsification: A classifier restricted to derivative features in this window performs no better than chance on site-disjoint validation.
predictions_foliage.why_broadband_misses: Requires contiguous sampling — impossible with 5 discrete bands.

This is the least contentious of the trait inferences, but it is still an inference: transcript abundance is not pigment concentration.

traits.trait: Chlorophyll-bearing, low-mesophyll stem tissue contributing to the canopy signal
traits.rationale: Directly implied by the published finding rather than inferred at a distance — elevated stem photosynthesis requires chlorophyll in the stem. The inference is only about the *proportion of a canopy patch* that this tissue occupies at 8 cm GSD, which is a canopy-architecture question the ground library must measure.

predictions_foliage.proposal_row: not in the §3.2 table — added by this desk study

predictions_foliage.why_broadband_misses: Outside the range of every RGB and most 5-band multispectral sensors entirely.

traits.trait: High specific leaf area, thin lamina, rapid leaf turnover
traits.rationale: The classic fast-growth end of the leaf economics spectrum, consistent with a vine that blankets a canopy in a season. Thin lamina means fewer internal air-cell interfaces and therefore a lower NIR plateau — but this is an AMPLITUDE effect, and §3.2 warns that amplitude differences are confounded by illumination. Ranked accordingly.

traits.trait: Two-layer blanket: vine layer draped over, not integrated into, host canopy
traits.rationale: Growth-habit trait rather than a molecular one; the genomic findings support only the growth *rate* that makes the habit possible. band_selection.weighting_note: Applying the prior as per-band feature WEIGHTS produces exactly zero effect: StandardScaler restores unit variance per band, and tree ensembles are invariant to monotone per-feature rescaling. §3.3(a) is only implementable as band selection.
